description: East-Asian-specific HWE analysis of UROC1 p.Trp285Ter homozygotes
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

Q="""query V($v:String!){ variant(variantId:$v, dataset: gnomad_r4){
 exome{ac an homozygote_count populations{id ac an homozygote_count}} } }"""
v=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":Q,"variables":{"v":"3-126504043-C-T"}},
   timeout=120,headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}).json()["data"]["variant"]
pops={p["id"]:p for p in v["exome"]["populations"]}
print("subpopulation ids available:", [k for k in pops if k.startswith("eas")])

eas=pops["eas"]; af=eas["ac"]/eas["an"]; N=eas["an"]/2
exp=af**2*N; obs=eas["homozygote_count"]
p_exc=stats.poisson.sf(obs-1,exp)
print("East Asian: AC=%d AN=%d (N=%d), AF=%.4f"%(eas["ac"],eas["an"],N,af))
print("  expected hom under HWE = %.2f ; observed = %d ; Poisson one-sided p(excess) = %.2e"%(exp,obs,p_exc))
print("  carrier freq in EAS = 1 in %.0f ; predicted biallelic genotype freq = 1 in %,.0f".replace(",","")%(1/(2*af),0) )
print("  predicted EAS homozygote frequency = 1 in %.0f"%(1/af**2))

for k in [k for k in pops if k.startswith("eas_")]:
    p=pops[k]; print("   ",k,"AC=%d AN=%d AF=%.4f hom=%d"%(p["ac"],p["an"],p["ac"]/p["an"] if p["an"] else 0,p["homozygote_count"]))

# Compare to reported-case count
reported_cases = 8   # conservative upper bound of individuals in literature since 1971
world_births_since_1971 = 55*130e6
expected_world = (af**2)  # EAS-specific; use global pLoF q instead below
print("\nPredicted biallelic p.Trp285Ter individuals alive in East Asia (pop 1.6e9): %.0f"%(af**2*1.6e9))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.5,4.8))
cats=["expected under HWE\nin gnomAD East Asians","observed homozygotes\nin gnomAD East Asians"]
ax.bar(cats,[exp,obs],color=["#5b6b7c","#b4553a"],width=0.5)
for i,val in enumerate([exp,obs]): ax.text(i,val+0.12,f"{val:.2f}" if i==0 else str(val),ha="center")
ax.set_ylabel("p.Trp285Ter homozygous individuals")
ax.set_title("UROC1 nonsense homozygotes are present in a population reference cohort\nEast Asian AF = %.3f%%, N = %d"%(af*100,N))
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
